outcomes.all_on: After All on, GPU summary Avg Util, Max Temp and Total Power are pressed alongside CPU/memory buttons; per-GPU buttons remain off.
outcomes.reset: Reset restored original visible User CPU, Available Memory, GPU Avg Util and Max Temp selections.
outcomes.run_zoom: Clicking a container run narrowed the chart from seven days to about17:56–17:59 around the selected run. Root inspected the retained screenshot: grid10s, a corresponding blue run bar and chart tooltip with a UTC Z timestamp. This supports zoom/display behavior, not daemon sampling-rate or retention guarantees.
outcomes.row_detail_limit: For this old run the row tooltip displays no data. Full status/last-seen/run-count metadata is not established for every row.
outcomes.shortcut: Machines > More options > View metrics opened Machine Metrics with the same machine selected in the dropdown and entity query. Numeric machine identity is retained only in local raw captures.
outcomes.restoration: Restored default chart and then verified card shortcut; selected team/host configuration unchanged.

limits: No backend sampling, upload cadence, retention, VM support or performance diagnosis tested. No paid/account/host mutation. Raw full DOM/screenshots remain local; published excerpts omit account/machine/device identifiers and renter history.
